functional.scope: Corrective source implementation resolving all 7 prior source counterexamples plus all 5 concrete PR #6798 pre-deployment source findings: (1) Real exact-pair rollback baseline FE tarball retrieval/verification (STAGING_FE_BASELINE_ARTIFACT_PATH / STAGING_FE_BASELINE_ARTIFACT_URI), removal of fabricated placeholder index.html in deploy/staging/bootstrap.sh, on-host archive SHA-256 + member digest verification, and full 5-service owner-closure rollback (operator-bff, runtime-manager, governance, deployment, lifecycle-projector); (2) Real HS256-authenticated security, tenant isolation, and RBAC gate in deploy/staging/pantheon-staging-collect-gates and scripts/deploy/staging_sanitize.py exercising GET /bff/me, POST /bff/switch-tenant, and POST /bff/command-confirmations with positive controls (HTTP 200) and strict negative controls (401 AUTH_REQUIRED unauthenticated, 403 FORBIDDEN tenant_scope on cross-tenant read/write, 403 FORBIDDEN role_check on viewer mutation; 404/405 never accepted); (3) Live PostgreSQL information_schema.columns pre/post migration catalog observation without static spec fallbacks, plus live old-app (rollback_baseline.backend_operator_bff_image) execution against the migrated schema; (4) Separate single-statement psql -c invocations for DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS and CREATE DATABASE during backup/restore verification; (5) Non-root IAP OS Login privilege elevation (sudo -n / sudo -E), Debian 12 docker-compose-plugin support, and GCE metadata-token docker login (oauth2accesstoken) to Artifact Registry before docker pull.

pr6798_blocking_source_findings_remediat.title: Security, tenant isolation, and RBAC gate is vacuous against real operator-bff routes
pr6798_blocking_source_findings_remediat.remediation: Replaced fake-token /bff/capabilities probes with real HS256 JWTs signed using PANTHEON_BFF_JWT_SECRET for operator and viewer personas in pantheon-staging-collect-gates. Added positive controls (GET /bff/me for operator and viewer -> 200, POST /bff/switch-tenant same-tenant -> 200) and negative controls (GET /bff/me unauthenticated -> 401 AUTH_REQUIRED; GET /bff/me X-Tenant-Id: tenant-bravo -> 403 FORBIDDEN precondition_failed=tenant_scope; POST /bff/switch-tenant tenant-bravo -> 403 FORBIDDEN precondition_failed=tenant_scope; POST /bff/command-confirmations viewer -> 403 FORBIDDEN precondition_failed=role_check), enforced fail-closed by staging_sanitize.verify_security_and_safety_readbacks.

pr6798_blocking_source_findings_remediat.title: Schema compatibility and old-app/new-schema verification are simulated, not observed
pr6798_blocking_source_findings_remediat.remediation: Removed SELECT /* PRE_MIGRATION_SCHEMA */ 1; and SELECT /* POST_MIGRATION_SCHEMA */ 1; and removed all fallback to mig_spec['old_app_schema'] / mig_spec['new_schema']. pantheon-staging-collect-gates now queries live PostgreSQL information_schema.columns before and after migration SQL execution, verifies added columns exist in the post-migration catalog, starts rollback_baseline.backend_operator_bff_image against the migrated database, verifies /bff/readyz (200), /bff/version (rollback_baseline.backend_commit), authenticated GET /bff/me (200), and SQL read compatibility, then restores the candidate BFF.

pr6798_blocking_source_findings_remediat.title: Backup/restore verification uses multi-statement DROP DATABASE ...; CREATE DATABASE ...; in a single psql -c call
pr6798_blocking_source_findings_remediat.remediation: Split restore database preparation and cleanup in deploy/staging/pantheon-staging-collect-gates into separate single-command psql -c invocations (DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS followed by CREATE DATABASE, plus post-verification DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS cleanup) with strict identifier validation. Updated test_staging_release.py fake psql to fail closed with 'ERROR:  DROP DATABASE cannot run inside a transaction block' if DROP DATABASE or CREATE DATABASE is ever combined in a multi-statement -c call.

pr6798_blocking_source_findings_remediat.title: Bare-Debian bootstrap fails under non-root IAP OS Login and lacks Artifact Registry authentication before docker pull
pr6798_blocking_source_findings_remediat.remediation: Updated deploy/staging/bootstrap.sh to stage rendered files in a user-owned local workdir and execute all root-path installs, mounts, secret mode checks, Caddy reloads, and Docker commands through run_priv (sudo -n), auto-elevate pantheon-staging-collect-gates via sudo -E when invoked by a non-root OS Login user, install docker-compose-plugin on Debian 12 bookworm, fetch an OAuth2 access token from the GCE metadata server for the attached runtime SA, and run docker login -u oauth2accesstoken --password-stdin https://asia-east1-docker.pkg.dev before docker pull.
